save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state and config to a .pyth file
load_checkpoint: load model weights from a checkpoint file with optional optimizer and scaler state restoration
load_train_checkpoint: load the last or specified checkpoint for training resuming with auto resume support
load_test_checkpoint: load a checkpoint for testing from TEST or TRAIN config paths with fallback logic
get_last_checkpoint: get the path to the most recent checkpoint file in a job directory
